Recruitment of Teaching Faculty on contract basis at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta, Patna. 
 
 
 
 
ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta, Patna- 801103 (Bihar) intends to fill up the posts Teaching Faculty from 
eligible candidates for a period of 01 (One) year on contract basis in various disciplines as mentioned in this 
advertisement.  
 
Eligible candidates, who want to appear in the interview, must send-  
(i) Scanned copy of Application Form with supporting documents to email: dean-bihta.bh@esic.gov.in by 12:00 Noon 
of 18.11.2026. 
(ii) Original Application Form with supporting  documents and original Demand Draft (as Interview Fee, if applicable) 
to The Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta, Patna- 801103 on the date of interview. 
 
• Date of interview: 19.11.2026 (Pre and Para Clinical), 20.10.2026 (Clinical Department)                                             
• Mode of Interview: Offline only.  
• Date for Eligibility of Qualifying Degree/ Experience: on the date of interview.

Note: 
1. These vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease as per the  actual requirement for the teaching &  
patient care. The competent authority reserves the right of any amendment, cancellation and changes to this 
advertisement as a whole or in part without assigning any reason or giving prior notice. 
 
 
Retired/ Working Professor may apply to vacant post of Associate Professor; their Salary will be as per the scale of Professor. Any 
Candidate can be appointed against any unfilled vacant reserved category post for 44 days with provision of possible extension. 
 
 
423-A/12/28/2026(T.F.) I/4586936/2026
 
  
2. Reservation will be as per Government of India guidelines issued from time to time. 
3. As per EWS guidelines posts are not carried forward , hence; in case of non - availability of EWS candidate;  other 
category candidates may be allowed provisionally to apply for the post subject to the condition that they will be 
considered for the post as an UR candidates & the selection will be only on merit basis. 
4. In case of non -availability of reserved category candidates in the advertised post , the vacancy may be filled up for 
less than 45 Days as de-reserved seats(s). 
5. All Candidates must have up -dated Medical  (NMC/ State Medical Council) with all post MBBS / MD/ MS  
Qualification(s). In case, candidate(s) do not have up -dated registration from Medical Council, they have to show 
“Applied for document(s)”  to concerned authority at the time of interview. In case, these two clauses are not 
fulfilled, the candidate either may not be interviewed or their results will remain with -held in case the expert 
committee allows them to appear at the interview. Even after that, if, candidate selected, they must have to submit 
updated Medical Registration Certificate on the time of reporting to join. 
6. Candidates working in Govt./ Autonomous/ Statutory Institution should preferably have “NOC” at the time of 
Interview from their Employer. In case of immediate non - availability of the same, copy of “applied for NOC” to be 
submitted at the time of Interview. 
7. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining as teaching faculty at ESIC Medical College, Bihta. 
 
Eligibility Criteria 
1. Age Limit as on 18.11.2026: 69 Years (Not Exceeding) 
Note:    
(i) The maximum tenure of such engagement will be till 70 years of age for teaching faculty whichever is earlier 
provided other 
 rules & regulations are satisfied. 
(ii) The EWS candidates should submit EWS Certificate as per Annexure - I of Govt. of India, Ministry of Personnel, 
Public Grievances & Pensions, DOPT Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res), dated 31.01.2019. 
(iii) The OBC (Non -Creamy Layer) Certificate should be issued and not prior to 01 (One) Year from the date of 
interview. It has to be as per the format applicable for job in Govt. of India and to be issued by an Officer not 
below the rank of Sub-Divisional Officer (अनुमंडल पदाधिकारी) or Equivalent Authority of the concerned State for 
Central Govt. job. 
(iv) Reservation for PH (Divyangjan) Candidate will be maintained as per GoI norms.  
 
2. Educational Qualifications: As per NMC (MCI) guidelines. 
 
3. Pay and Allowances:  
Professor Associate Professor Assistant Professor 
Fixed Basic- ₹ 1,18,500/- & other 
allowance 
Fixed Basic- ₹ 78,800/- & other 
allowance 
Fixed Basic- ₹ 67,700/- & other 
allowance 
Monthly Pay will be paid according to data available in Biometric Attendance System regarding attendance 
marked by the person concerned for his/ her working hours.  In case of engagement of retire employees/ 
pensioners, they may be allowed to draw total pay  without any deduction as it is not a case of re - employment in 
terms of Central Civil Services (Fixation of Pay of Re -employed Pensioner) Orders , 1986 and retired employees/ 
pensioners can continue to draw pension and dearness relief on pension during their period of contractual 
engagement. 
 
4. Terms of Contract: 
(i) The tenure of all above post(s) will be for 01 (One) year OR attainment of 70 years of age; whichever is earlier. 
(ii) The contractual engagement may be terminated/ discontinued from either side giving one-month prior notice to 
this effect without assigning reason. In case of spot resignation  by the selected candidate, one month’s salary is 
to be deposited to ESIC Account through Challan. 
(iii) No claim for any service benefits like PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance /Benefits, Seniority, Promotion 
etc. will be admissible. 
(iv) This, being a contractual appointment, absence from work for a period beyond the  07 (S even) days without 
proper permission of the competent authority will amount to voluntary abandonment of engagement and  
automatic termination. The teaching faculty  is required to mark attendance manually as well as on Aadha ar 
Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily during scheduled working days. 
(v) Other terms and condition will be applicable as issued by Competent Authority from time to time.

7.   Selection Procedure: 
(i) The Selection will be made on the basis of acquired academic credentials and performance of candidate in 
interview before the Selection Board. 
(ii) Result will be displayed in Website: www.mcpatna.esic.gov.in and www.esic.gov.in. Offer of Appointment will 
be sent through E -mail. Selected candidates will have to join as per instructions mentioned in  offer of 
appointment. 
 
8. Important Note: 
(i) The Candidate(s) may ascertain their eligibility and should report for interview on the scheduled date and time 
for Interview. 
(ii) Application should be submitted for each post separately and in the prescribed format only. The application 
submitted in any other format or incomplete application will be summarily rejected.  Wrong declarations/  
submission of false information or any other action contrary to law shall lead to cancellation of the 
candidature at any stage. 
(iii) Mere submission of Application does not confer any right to the Candidate to be eligible for Interview unless 
they report on the scheduled date and time for Interview with required documents as mentioned. 
(iv) Opportunity of interview given to candidates will be on provisional basis subject to detailed scrutiny of 
eligibility criteria. 
(v) The Dean, ESIC MCH, Bihta reserves the right to cancel/ postpone the Recruitment Process at any stage at its 
discretion and such decision will be binding on all concerned. 
(vi) Candidates may contact Nodal Officer of Recruitment Cell, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta, Patna - 
801103 through E-mail: dean-bihta.bh@esic.gov.in  for any further query. 
(vii) No TA/ DA will be paid to candidate(s) for appearing in the Interview or submission of any document.

 दिन ांक Date:  05/11/2026 
 
व्यक्तिगत साक्षात्कार (PI) एवं दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन हेतु अनंतिम रूप से शॉर्टलिस्ट किए गए अभ्यर्थिय ों की संशोधित सूची 
 उप. प्रबंधक की भर्ती – (मैक े निकल- इरेक्शन / सिविल- क ं स्ट्रक्शन / इलेक्ट्र िकल- इरेक्शन/ 
 सी और आई - निर्माण/ सुरक्षा/पर्यावरण प्रबंधन) 
Revised List of Provisionally Shortlisted Candidates for Personal Interview (PI) & Document Verification for the 
Posts of Dy. Manager (Mechanical- erection/Civil- construction/Electrical- Erection 
/ C & I – Erection/ Safety/Environment Management)  
 
 
                                    संदर्भ: विज्ञापन सं. पीएलआर/ पार्श्व/02/2025/06,दिन ांक: 30/04/2025 
                                                      Ref: Advt. No. PLR/Lateral/02/2025/06,  Dated: 30/04/2025 
 
 
क ृ पया दस्तावेज ों क े  सत्यापन और व्यक्तिगत साक्षात्कार क े  लिए उपस्थित होने से पहले निम्नलिखित दिशानिर्देश पढ़ें और पालन 
किया।  
The following guidelines may kindly be read & followed before appearing for Document Verification and Personal 
Interview. 
1. साक्षात्कार और अंतिम चयन प्रासंगिक विज्ञापन में निर्धारित सभी आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने और आवेदक द्वारा अपने ऑनलाइन 
आवेदन में प्रस्तुत सभी आवश्यक दस्तावेज ों क े  सत्यापन क े  अधीन हैं। 
       Interview and final selection are subject to meeting all requirements as laid down in the relevant advertisement 
and verification of all the required documents furnished by the applicant in his/her ONLINE application.  
 
2. जिन उम्मीदवार ों क े  नाम शॉर्टलिस्ट किए गए हैं, उन्हें विज्ञापन में निर्धारित अपेक्षित पात्रता मानदंड ों को पूरा करने और परीक्षा क े  अधीन 
उपरोक्त पद क े  लिए ऑनलाइन आवेदन में उनक े  द्वारा की गई प्रविष्टिय ों क े  आधार पर दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन और व्यक्तिगत साक्षात्कार 
(पीआई) क े  लिए अनंतिम रूप से बुलाया जाता है। यदि भर्ती प्रक्रिया क े  किसी भी चरण में भर्ती या शामिल होने क े  बाद, यह पाया जाता 
है कि उसक े  द्वारा प्रदान की गई जानकारी गलत / अपूर्ण / झूठी है या प्रासंगिक विज्ञापन / अधिसूचना में निर्धारित पात्रता मानदंड ों क े  
अनुरूप नह ीं है, या यदि यह पाया जाता है कि उसने किसी भी सामग्री की जानकारी छिपाई / विक ृ त की है, उसकी उम्मीदवारी / 
नियुक्ति को बिना कोई कारण बताए रद्द कर दिया जाएगा। 
The candidates who have been shortlisted are provisionally called for Document Verification & Personal Interview 
(PI) based on the entries made by them in the ONLINE application and Written Exam ( CBT) for the above 
post subject to fulfilling the requisite eligibility criteria as stipulated in the Advertisement. If at any stage of the 
recruitment process including after recruitment or joining, it is detected that information provided by him/her is 
incorrect/incomplete/false or is not in conformity with the eligibility criteria as prescribed in the relevant 
Advertisement/Notification, or if it is found that he/she has concealed/distorted any material information, his/her 
candidature/appointment will be cancelled without assigning any reason thereof.

3. उम्मीदवार ों को पीडब्ल्यूबीडी सहित प्रत्येक विषय में श्रेणी-वार रिक्तिय ों क े  अंक ों क े आधार पर (100 में से प्राप्त) में दस्तावेज सत्यापन 
(डीवी) क े  लिए 1:5 क े  अनुपात में शॉर्टलिस्ट किया गया है। 
The candidates have been shortlisted in a ratio of 1: 5 for Document Verification (DV) on the basis  of marks 
(obtained out of 100) as per category-wise vacancies in each discipline including PwBD as applicable. 
 
4. दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन और व्यक्तिगत साक्षात्कार (पीआई)चुने आवेदक ों 5 व ीं मंजिल, डीवीसी टावर्स, वीआईपी रोड (उल्टाड ांगा क े  पास), 
कोलकाता -700054 में उल्लिखित विवरण क े  अनुसार आयोजित किया जाएगा । 
       Document verification & Interview of the shortlisted applicants will be held at 5th Floor, DVC Towers, VIP Road 
(Near Ultadanga), Kolkata-700054. 
 
5. उम्मीदवार ों की शॉर्टलिस्टिंग डीवी और पीआई में उपस्थित होने क े  लिए उम्मीदवार ों की शॉर्टलिस्टिंग अनंतिम है। अंतिम चयन विज्ञापन

क्र े डेंशियल्स क े  सत्यापन क े  अधीन है।             
The shortlisting of candidates for appearing in DV & PI is provisional. Final selection is subject to meeting all the 
requirements as laid down in the Advertisement and verification of all the required documents and credentials 
as furnished by the applicants in their ONLINE application.  
 
6. दस्तावेज ों क े  सत्यापन क े  बाद व्यक्तिगत साक्षात्कार (पीआई) क े  समय मूल रूप से स्व-सत्यापित फोटोकॉपी क े  एक सेट क े  साथ 
अनिवार्य रूप से लाए जाने वाले दस्तावेज ों की सूची: - 
      List of Documents to be brought mandatorily at the time of Document Verification followed by Personal Interview 
(PI) in ORIGINAL with one set of self-attested PHOTOCOPIES positively: - 
 
i) ऑन-लाइन अंतिम प्रस्तुत आवेदन पत्र का प्रिंटआउट। Printout of On-Line final submitted Application Form.   
ii)  जन्म तिथि का प्रमाण (कक्षा दसव ीं बोर्ड प्रमाणपत्र या स्क ू ल छोड़ने का प्रमाण पत्र या कक्षा दसव ीं पास िंग      सर्टिफिक े ट)। Proof of

items.doc_text:
The National Cybercrime Threat Analysis Unit (NCTAU)  of Indian Cyber Crime 
Coordination Centre (I4C)  and CERT-In, Ministry of Electronics and IT  has noticed a trend in 
cyber-attacks based cyber frauds on Banks, Non -Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs)  and 
FinTech Companies. These attacks are financially motivated and are being carried out with the help 
of Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents leading to machine speed compromise. Multi-crore unauthorized 
transaction through fund disbursement systems and APIs are being found in individual cases. 
How Do the Attackers Operate? 
 Perpetrators exploit unpatched software or  mis-configured internet exposed  Servers / IT 
systems to compromise the infrastructure. This also includes customer end complaint 
interface. 
 Hackers then target automated fund disbursement systems or special interfaces (APIs) used 
for payments and fund transfers. Use of Agentic AI Framework makes the attack possible at 
machine speed. 
 The money is sent to “mule” accounts (accounts used by criminals) across different banks 
and then quickly moved or withdrawn through IMPS/NEFT. 
 Then perpetrator delete records and hide their tracks so that investigation becomes difficult. 
What Should Financial Institutions Do? 
All banks, NBFCs, FinTechs, payment aggregators/gateways and other financial entities are 
advised to implement, on priority, the measures in CERT-In Advisory CIAD-2026-0046 “Threat Actors 
Exploiting Payment and Disbursement APIs for Unauthorized Fund Transfers in BFSI Entities ” (9 
October 2026, Severity: Critical) and CERT -In Advisory CIAD-2026-0049 “AI Agents as Attack 
Vectors” (15 October 2026, Severity: Critical), and to align their controls with frameworks such as the 
CERT-In “Blueprint for Reducing Exposure and Defending against AI -Assisted Vulnerabilities 
Exploitation in Digital Infrastructure ” (May 2026) and the cyber security frameworks prescribed by 
their respective sectoral regulators. 
 Report any cyber incident to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing it. 
 Banks and NBFCs must report to RBI on the DAKSH portal within six hours of detection. 
 NBFCs and Fintechs may contact I4C for bulk reporting of fraudulent transactions on the 
NCRP-CFCFRMS portal so that defrauded money can be frozen 
National Cybercrime Threat Analysis Unit (NCTAU) Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C) 
AI-Assisted Financially Motivated Cyber Attacks on NBFCs and FinTech Platforms 
TAU/ADV/020 | Dated: 3rd Nov 2026 
 
 
Additional Measures to of Safeguarding: 
 Keep a complete list of all digital interfaces (APIs) used for payments and remove or switch off 
old, unused or test interfaces. 
 Bank’s Chief Information Security Officer’s Team and Transaction Monitoring Team and IT Team 
may work in close coordination for proactively mitigating the API attack risks. 
 Set daily and per-transaction limits, verify beneficiary names and accounts, and watch for unusual 
speed of transactions. 
 Banks Check for NBFC’s Access token failures from non-whitelisted IPs. 
 Strengthen the customer facing & complaint receiving infrastructure for any potential attempts of 
intrusion. Thorough secure architecture review may be conducted to prevent lateral movement. 
 Sudden change in transaction narration patterns  and beneficiary profiles or volume may be 
monitored by transaction monitoring team. 
 Make sure money cannot be sent out unless all earlier checks (KYC, approval, etc.) have been 
completed properly. 
 Run authorised red -team exer cises that simulate machine -speed attacks, and measure how 
quickly SOC and payment controls respond. 
 
National Cybercrime Threat Analysis Unit (NCTAU) Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C)
